notes: files: a generated adapter package (adapters/zzsynth for the evaluator); observations: what each RunJSONBidderTest call received when `go test -vet=off` ran it.
observation.test is t.Name() (subtests keep their /suffix); root is path.Join("adapters/zzsynth", dir), what the manifest records as fixture_root.

cases: expect=match requires the evaluator to reproduce the observations of that test exactly with no setup; expect=loud requires an error naming blame or setup statements, never a clean run; expect=none means Go makes no call and the evaluator must report no clean run.
